description: Produce a correct, faster CUDA-backend implementation of PKB problem 1, an all-reduce sum over one tensor.

hardware.interconnect: Do not assume a topology; the evaluator will record nvidia-smi topo -m.

constraints: Preserve the solution function signature and all-rank sum semantics.
Target exactly two NVIDIA A40 ranks for this Scholar plumbing run.
Return a new tensor and do not mutate the input tensor.
Produce one complete Python module at the filename 1_allreduce_cuda.py for the PKB cuda backend.
Use only dependencies and operations available in the pinned ParallelKernelBench evaluator.
The evaluator will run five bfloat16 correctness trials at atol=1e-2 and rtol=1e-2 before any timing result is accepted.
Do not claim correctness or performance in the candidate source.
reference_implementation:
import torch
import torch.distributed as dist


@torch.no_grad()
def solution(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    out = tensor.clone()
    dist.all_reduce(out, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM)
    return out
